podcast.body: As the lead single from her 2014 album "1989," this song became a number one hit on the Hot 100 and was subsequently replaced at the top spot by her own song, "Blank Space," making her the only solo woman to achieve this feat. "In 2014, the lead single from her album 1989, Shake It Off, seeded the top spot to her own blank space."

The speaker only knew three lyrics from her, specifically from "Shake It Off," implying a different cultural penetration compared to classic rock anthems. "I can't tell you, they're only three lyrics I know from Taylor Swift or shake it off. That's it."

podcast.body: This song was the number one debut that led off Taylor Swift's "blockbuster album 1989." It represents an instance of a superstar debuting at number one with a well-regarded hit from a highly anticipated follow-up album. "Taylor Swift, who led off her blockbuster album 1989 with the number 1 debut Shake It Off."
